Anonymized FTImage-style series list

Mirrors the FTImage site: series rows are a > div.desc > span.total inside a scrolling div.os-viewport and carry no id / data-* identity attribute, so discovery must fall back to row text. The 8th row (MPR-Sag_bone) starts below the fold and is only enumerated after scrolling. A second, interfering div.os-viewport (no series rows) sits lower in the document to mirror the real page's two os-viewports — the discovery root must be the first one and cannot count interference content.
